items.quote: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses
items.claim: The children of Israel followed Moses' instructions

items.quote: and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment
items.claim: The Israelis borrowed precious items from Egyptians
items.object: jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment

items.quote: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians
items.claim: God gave the Israelis favor with the Egyptians

items.quote: they lent unto them such things as they required
items.claim: The Egyptians lent to the Israelis whatever they requested
The Israelis took valuables from the Egyptians
